dct_description_sm: This multi-year project was designed to address the need to incorporate climate change and sea level rise impacts into community planning in Canadian Atlantic Aboriginal communities. The overall objectives of the initiative were: (1) to evaluate the potential impacts of sea level rise on existing community infrastructure and to conduct risk assessments; (2) to identify the potential climate change impacts, such as sea level rise and shore erosion, on future community planning; and (3) to assist communities in prioritizing community projects and planning to adapt to climate change in the context of its effects on infrastructure (focus on infrastructure designs). In its first year (Phase I), the project focused on data collection and GIS development. The second year of the project built upon work completed in Phase I (2009-2010).
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Identifying Adaptation Strategies for Climate Change and Sea Level Rise in Community Planning
